title: applied-ml-field-ops-notes-nov22-2027
body:
Field ops weekly capture — brief / raw notes (intended for lab channel and SRE sync).

Date range: 2027-11-15 -> 2027-11-22
Owner: Maya Chen (applied-ml)
Summary: Focus this week on three threads: (1) narrow-precision quant probe for Mistral-style 7B on GPU x2 (fp16->int4 mix), (2) eval triage for regression seen in customer beta (short chat completions), (3) onboarding pipeline for community model 'cobalt-7b' into the catalog with KV-cache compatibility checks.

Notes and observations (raw):
- High-level: quant experiments show consistent token-level perplexity lift at seq>1024 for aggressive per-channel int4 with no per-layer fallback; however human eval shows subtle repetition on temperature 0.8.
- KV-cache interplay: observed ~3-5% throughput drop when using full KV prefetch + int4 attention kernel on A100s at batch=8. Hypothesis: memory alignment in custom kernel causes extra memcpy.
- Regression triage: customer reported quality drop in chat flows after model swap -> traced to model variant mismatch (cobalt-7b-v2 was served with different EOS token mapping). Patch applied to runtime mapping layer in staging.

Experiment log (short):
1) quant-probe-2027-11-17: model=mistral-7b, quant=per-channel-int4, fallback=none, backend="cuda-kernels-v3". Dataset=eval-chat-mini (5k queries). Result: token-perplexity +8% vs fp16, mean response latency -12% (good). Human pass rate (rating>=3) dropped from 74%->68% for creative prompts. Notes: enable selective fp16 for final layers next run.
2) kv-alignment-check-2027-11-18: model=cobalt-7b (candidate), config=quantized-int8-per-tensor, kv-prefetch=true. Observed throughput -3.8%, transient GC on allocator when kv size ~1.2GB. Action: instrument kernel memcpy counts and allocator stats.
3) eval-smoke-2027-11-20: regression-replay on customer-XYZ dataset (2k sessions). Root cause: token-id offset bug introduced by tokenizer version mismatch. Mitigation: add token version guard in onboarding script and block model activation until tokenizer hash validated.

Open questions / hypotheses:
- Is the perf regression for KV+int4 systemic across GPU families (A100 vs H100) or specific to kernel implementation? Need H100 runs with same kernel flags.
- Does selective fp16 for last N transformer layers restore human pass rate with minimal latency impact? Candidate N=2 and N=4 planned.
- Should we require tokenizer-hash gating in the Dedicated onboarding flow or only in Private? Prefer uniform gating to avoid surprises.

Action items (owners):
- Maya: schedule H100 reproducer runs (priority) and attach allocator trace to ticket ML-724. Target: 2027-11-26.
- Rajat: prototype mixed-precision policy (fp16 for last 2 layers) and submit bench results. Target: 2027-11-25.
- Ivy: add tokenizer-hash gating to model-onboard pipeline and create playbook entry for "token-mismatch rollback". Target: 2027-11-29.
- Liam: add kernel memcpy counters to cuda-kernels-v3 and publish nightly histogram. Target: 2027-11-24.

Meeting snippets and syncs: 
- Quick sync with SRE (2027-11-19): SRE recommends enabling allocator debug on a canary host and watching for elevated memcpy spikes during cold-starts. Also suggested looking into enabling async memcpy to reduce stall.
- Product check-in (2027-11-21): product asks for impact summary if we hold cobalt-7b onboarding; estimate: 2–3 customer demos delayed. Recommended soft-block until tokenizer gating in place.

Risks / mitigations:
- Risk: rolling an aggressively quantized model without tokenizer validation can silently alter outputs -> Mitigation: require tokenizer hash check + small deterministic smoke test (5 canonical prompts) before enable.
- Risk: kernel-level memcpy overhead might negate latency benefits -> Mitigation: short-term use per-tensor int8 fallbacks for KV heavy routes until kernel fix lands.

Quick checklist for next week:
- Run H100 reproducer (Maya)
- Roll mixed-precision probe (Rajat)
- Merge tokenizer-gate PR to onboarding (Ivy)
- Nightly histogram for memcpy counters (Liam)
- Prepare short 1-pager for product summarizing tradeoffs if quant rollout delayed >1 week (Maya)

Notes-to-self: keep experiment names consistent (project-YYYY-MM-DD), annotate every trial with exact kernel sha + docker image tag, attach raw logs to Linear ticket.

References and useful links: see linked_artifacts. For quick replay: linear ticket ML-724 contains reproducer and staging logs.

End of capture.
